disclaimer: Decision support only. Not validated for clinical use. Requires clinician review.
small_sample_caveats: Full PhysioNet/CinC Challenge 2019 cohort (39581 patients, US hospital systems A & B); not validated on Romanian ICU populations.
Challenge 2019 PSV files omit vasopressors, GCS, urine output, microbiology, and ICD codes; missingness and lab-recency flags are explicitly modeled.
